.card rules conflict with a special element ID.
ID CLASS TYPE · p 0 0 1 · .card p 0 1 1 · #featured p 1 0 1

Read the diagram: 1. Count each selector category. 2. Compare ID column first. 3. If tied, compare
class-like then type-like columns.
ID column එක මුලින් compare කරන්න. ඊට පෙස්Jස් class සහ type columns බලන්න.

p { color: gray; }             /* 0,0,1 */
.card p { color: blue; }       /* 0,1,1 */
#featured p { color: green; }  /* 1,0,1 */

Expected result: Green wins for a paragraph matching all three in the same origin, layer and
importance.
Interview question: Can many class selectors outweigh one ID selector?
Answer: Not in ordinary specificity comparison; the ID column is compared first.
